# Psalms of Solomon — Psalm 7 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Vindobonensis) | **Section:** God Will Not Abandon His People

---

**7:1** Do not stay far from us, O God —
do not let our enemies, who hate us without cause, fall upon us!

**7:2** Have you cast us off? No! Do not cast us off, O God!
Why would you turn your face away from us?

**7:3** If you do, the nations will grind us down in their arrogance,
and there will be no one to rescue us.

**7:4** But you have been our God from the very beginning;
our hope rests in you, O LORD.

**7:5** We will not abandon your covenant;
we will not let our heart stray from you.

**7:6** Your mercy is upon us, O LORD our God;
your mercy upon the people of Israel forever and ever.

**7:7** For you scattered us among the nations because of our sins —
yet you have not abandoned us completely.

**7:8** For you are our shield, O God;
when we call out to you, hear us!

**7:9** For you show mercy to the house of Jacob;
you will not hide your face from them forever.

**7:10** What nation is as great as you, O LORD?
Who has such a faithful God in their midst?

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering prioritizing poetic force and contemporary resonance.*
